preamble.summary: Psalm 89 — the Davidic-covenant lament at the close of Book III ('Where is your steadfast love of old, which by your faithfulness you swore to David?'). Sparse Qumran attestation.
preamble.notable_variants: Davidic-covenant lament; closes Book III. No significant content variants. Minor orthographic variation only (the standard Qumran plene-spelling tendency).
preamble.scroll_condition: Fragmentary attestation; no continuous DSS coverage.
